pr.title: Star items and show only the starred ones

acceptance.evidence: migrations/0002_add_starred.sql adds starred NOT NULL DEFAULT 0; test/starred.test.js 'AC-1' checks the 3 seeded items all read 0 after migrations.
src/index.js item() prefixes '★ ' only when starred; test 'AC-2' asserts exact li text for starred and unstarred rows.
WHERE starred = 1 ORDER BY id; test 'AC-3' stars 3 then 1 and expects [First, Third] in id order.
Default show is 'all' with no filter, ordered by id; test 'AC-4' checks '/' and '/?show=all' return all three in order.
VIEWS links: 'Starred only' on the full list, 'All items' on the starred list; test 'AC-5' asserts both anchors exactly.
Object.hasOwn guard returns 400 with no list; test 'AC-6' covers Starred, none, empty and __proto__ and asserts no <li>.
traffic/routes.json contains '/?show=starred'; test 'AC-7' asserts it. scripts/traffic-config-check.mjs accepts query strings, and tests/traffic-config.test.sh covers that.

findings.what:
In the 'No starred items' state test, `expect(listed(html)).toBeDefined()` can never fail, because listed() always returns an array. The empty-list claim is only covered indirectly by the

message check.
The README mentions `?show=starred` but not `?show=all`, the 'Starred only' / 'All items' links, or the 400 for other `show` values.
findings.fix: Add one line saying `show` accepts all or starred and anything else answers 400.
